_comment: Instrument spec for `python -m cct2.run portfolio --spec instruments.json`.
One entry per instrument. Costs are per instrument because a single spread
figure cannot be correct for gold and for EURUSD at once, and at this trade
size cost realism changes the sign of the result.
spread / slippage / stop_slippage are in PRICE units of that instrument.
contract_size is units per 1.00 lot: 100 oz for XAUUSD, 100000 for FX majors.
commission_per_lot is charged per lot PER SIDE.
Get the numbers from your own broker's contract specification, and if you are
unsure, use the worse figure. Optimistic cost assumptions are the second most
common way a backtest lies, after look-ahead.
